Role Purpose
Deliver FWA subscriber acquisition and acquisition revenue through productive, compliant sales territories and channels, strengthening direct-sales execution across 4G and 5G propositions.

Scope of Work
1. Target Cascade — Translate Circle targets into branch, cluster and sales-force objectives by addressable market and product proposition.
2. Field Sales Leadership — Lead branch reviews, pipeline discipline, field coverage, sales quality and corrective action on underperforming territories.
3. Channel Mix — Increase productive direct sales while coordinating with partner-led channels under national commercial direction.
4. Conversion & Activation — Coordinate with delivery teams to move qualified leads and sales orders through successful activation.
5. Sales Force Effectiveness — Partner with capability teams on onboarding, deployment, performance and field coaching.
6. Quality & Controls — Drive compliant selling, valid customer registration and early-life usage quality.

Requirements
Education and experience
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Operations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Strong experience managing consumer field sales, channel productivity and geographically distributed sales teams.

Functional competencies
Territory management; sales forecasting; channel execution; sales quality; coaching. Strong spreadsheet, presentation and reporting literacy appropriate to the role.

Behavioral competencies
Ownership and follow-through; clear communication; collaboration across functions; analytical problem-solving; customer and commercial orientation. Leadership and decision complexity should be assessed in proportion to actual role scope.

wo-jpfa-JR3012.d:
PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu, Sidoarjo)

Ringkasan Pekerjaan

Sanitation Operator bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan kebersihan dan sanitasi fasilitas produksi PT Japfa Food Indonesia sesuai dengan standar kebersihan dan keamanan pangan yang berlaku.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

* Melaksanakan prosedur sanitasi dan pembersihan mesin produksi, peralatan, dan area kerja sesuai dengan standar operasional prosedur (SOP) yang ditetapkan.
* Memastikan semua peralatan dan area kerja bebas dari kontaminasi silang.
* Menggunakan bahan kimia pembersih dan desinfektan dengan benar dan aman.
* Melakukan inspeksi rutin terhadap kebersihan fasilitas dan melaporkan temuan atau penyimpangan kepada atasan.
* Mencatat dan mendokumentasikan semua aktivitas sanitasi dan pembersihan yang dilakukan.
* Menjaga ketersediaan dan kebersihan alat-alat kebersihan yang digunakan.
* Melaksanakan tindakan perbaikan segera jika ditemukan masalah sanitasi.
* Mematuhi semua peraturan kesehatan, keselamatan, dan lingkungan kerja yang berlaku.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

* Memahami prinsip-prinsip kebersihan dan sanitasi industri pangan. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
* Teliti, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab.
* Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift.
* Memiliki fisik yang sehat dan kuat

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh.
